lines.text: Four brackets, all multiplied. Don't multiply them out!
lines.caption: Four brackets, all multiplied. Don't multiply them out!

lines.text: There's a trick that makes it collapse.
lines.caption: There's a trick that makes it collapse.

lines.text: What is the value of the whole product?
lines.caption: What is the value of the whole product?

lines.text: Bring in a helper: one minus one over two.
lines.caption: Bring in a helper: one minus one over two.

lines.text: Helper times the first bracket is one minus one over four. Each step knocks over the next one!
lines.caption: Helper times the first bracket is one minus one over four. Each step knocks over the next one!

lines.text: The chain collapses to one minus one over two hundred fifty-six squared.
lines.caption: The chain collapses to one minus one over two hundred fifty-six squared.

lines.text: We used one half, so double the result!
lines.caption: We used one half, so double the result!

lines.text: Two, minus two over two hundred fifty-six squared!
lines.caption: Two, minus two over two hundred fifty-six squared!

lines.text: Why does the helper work? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why does the helper work? The full lesson shows two ways, plus every trap.
